_comment: Human-editable and authoritative: the model never overrules this file.
locked — tokens that must survive verbatim into German (content/SCHEMA.md 'Do not translate').
The §3.1 dial parameter names (duty, fidelity, latency, noise, control, contrary) and the
receipt symbol 'u' are NOT locked here although SCHEMA.md lists them: they are composed in
JS and never appear in map prose, while 'noise'/'control' are ordinary English words that
would misfire on mechanism text. If they ever enter the map as literals, add them back.
preferred — the terms of art, fixed once so the site never calls one thing by three names.
en:    the English term as it appears in source text (stem, matched case-insensitively)
use:   the German term the translation must use
match: the stem the compliance check looks for in the German (defaults to 'use')
